Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one photorealistic cinematic BACKGROUND for an elegant developer portfolio website, not a website mockup. Portrait 1:3 composition, highest available native resolution. One very tall coherent uninterrupted environment, intended for a slow vertical camera reveal while scrolling. Central 65% must remain pale, quiet, low contrast negative space so dark text is readable anywhere. Strongest visual detail at the outer edges. Carefully art-directed cinematic depth, large soft light sources, subtle atmospheric perspective, exquisite material realism, restrained palette. No UI, no cards, no devices, no people, no lettering, no logos or watermarks. No collage, no stacked scenes, no horizontal section seams, no repeating floors, no black regions. Make one complete continuous scene; any floor only in the bottom 12%. Light motion will be added in code, so no drawn motion arrows.
ÁTRIO DE LUZ. An immense futuristic pearl-white glass atrium, translucent fluted glass planes and very slender silver architectural edges along the far margins, cool daylight entering through a high angled skylight. Long faint diagonal shadows on a smooth pearl wall. A whisper of powder-blue refraction, a soft reflective satin floor at the very bottom. Architectural photography with gentle anamorphic bloom, sophisticated sci-fi film set, airy scale. The upper half is open luminous volume and the side glass structures continue all the way down. Cool silver, ice blue and white, luminous yet with gentle depth.
